msrp_notes.basis: Base MSRP at the start of the model year, before destination ($1,390) and order fees; options such as paint, wheels, interior and FSD are not included.
msrp_notes.2024 Long Range AWD: $45,990 at the January 2024 launch, raised to $47,490 in April 2024.
msrp_notes.2024 Performance: Launched April 2024 at $52,990; $54,990 by the end of 2024.
msrp_notes.2025 RWD: Only a small number of MY2025 base RWD cars exist; Tesla dropped the trim from the US lineup.
msrp_notes.2026 naming: Tesla renamed Long Range RWD/AWD to Premium RWD/AWD for 2026 and added the cheaper 'Standard'. The dashboard maps Premium -> Long Range so year buckets stay comparable.
